intro.text: An ocean to the northeast of Roshar's main continent.

items.text: Dalinar Kholin once suggested that he, Evi and Adolin take a holiday at the Steamwater Ocean, since Evi had grown tired of Alethkar's wind and cold.
For several weeks the airship Fourth Bridge flew over the Steamwater Ocean to test its endurance, taking shelter in coves and laits when highstorms came.
